messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您想知道今天美國黃金的即時價格，建議您查看可靠的金融資訊網站（如 Bloomberg、Reuters、Kitco 等）或使用交易平台的行情頁面。一般來說，黃金價格會以每盎司美元（USD/oz）為單位報價，並且每天都會隨著市場供需、美元走勢、地緣政治等因素波動。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide typical gold price or mention that it's around $X per ounce. But we should be careful. We can say we don't have real-time data. Provide approximate range. Or we can say we can't fetch live data. We can provide a general answer: "As of the last close, gold was around $X per ounce." But we don't know the exact. We could say "I don't have real-time data." That might be best.
